findings: The current source now converts broker time to UTC for the 18:00-22:00 entry window, rollover blackout, and 23:00 exit; evaluates the card's closed-M15 Bollinger/RSI bounce; uses the SMA20 middle band target and exact 1.5-ATR stop; and performs management and exits before entry-only filters. Those headline remediation claims were independently confirmed.

StrategyDailyEntryHalt compares current ACCOUNT_EQUITY with g_qm_ks_day_start_equity. This includes floating P&L and therefore does not implement the approved card's 2.0% daily realized-loss entry halt; it also collapses that separate control into an equity-drawdown test.

Strategy_ExitSignal is true only while UTC hhmm is at least strategy_exit_hhmm and below 23:55. A quote gap or failed close can therefore leave exposure open when the mandatory 23:00 exit deasserts at 23:55 and stays false through midnight. The close requirement must remain asserted until the position is confirmed closed.

OnInit declares no QM_FrameworkDeclareExecutionContract for the M15 host cadence, and the EA adds Trade/Trade.mqh outside the QM_Common include chain even though no direct CTrade use is required. The host contract is not fail-closed and the framework corset is not clean.
